external_only_references.version_note: Official Dutch-language EUR-Lex record; the English official text and instrument identity were reviewed on 2026-10-23. Verify the decision and national notifications before treating the EU Visa Application Platform as operational. The reference does not establish local-copy acceptance or topic coverage.

The official Dutch route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.

external_only_references.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1240 establishing ETIAS
external_only_references.version_note: EUR-Lex identifies the current consolidated version dated 12 June 2026. On 2026-10-23 the official ETIAS FAQ said the system was not operating and no applications were being collected; the Commission scheduled launch for Q4 2026 without an exact date. Recheck official operational status and the actual residence document before applying. The Dutch route is recorded but its text was not independently checked. No local copy or topic-completion finding is implied.
